purpose: Reproducible correctness/performance comparison protocol for scale-aware representations from local detail to solar-system overview. This is a workload contract, not a result.

source_workload.pin_rule: A run must record the exact source commit and SHA-256 of the workload bytes; a changed source workload requires a new receipt and must not inherit previous results.

comparison_tracks.objective: Measure pure-Rust hierarchy/apparent-size decision correctness before comparing graphics backends.

compared_profiles.reference: Cesium documents 8–16 as a common higher-fidelity starting range.

comparison_tracks.note: These are comparable pixel-error policy settings, not a claim that Symtropy and Cesium implement identical LOD algorithms or have already been compared.

comparison_tracks.objective: Compare actual renderers only when both can consume identical canonical geometry, camera samples, visibility rules and asset-residency scenarios.
required_controls: same source geometry and asset bytes
same camera path and physical viewport dimensions
same field of view, clipping/depth configuration and visibility rules where supported
same target hardware, OS, driver and GPU backend where feasible
separately reported backend/toolchain versions and supported feature differences
independent projection/geometry oracle for correctness scoring
comparison_tracks.non_comparability_rule: Do not publish a head-to-head performance claim when source geometry, content completeness, camera samples or visual-error definitions differ.

workload_cases.mandatory_outcome: selected content remains visible, or an explicit protected-detail-unavailable result is emitted

workload_cases.risk: missing child tiles create false empty space
workload_cases.mandatory_outcome: retain a ready parent until fully covering replacement content is resident; otherwise fail explicitly

workload_cases.risk: origin jump or proxy scale discontinuity
workload_cases.mandatory_outcome: canonical positions remain unchanged and the camera-relative discontinuity stays within the fixture budget
position/projection error remains under the independent oracle limits

workload_cases.risk: absolute f32 coordinate use or excessive size exaggeration
workload_cases.mandatory_outcome: no absolute-f32 astronomical placement; actual physical radius remains separate from presentation radius

workload_cases.risk: selected feature identity lost after scale transitions
workload_cases.mandatory_outcome: the same semantic entity and canonical position are restored

workload_cases.risk: loading, unavailable assets, invalid coverage claims or shuffled ECS ordering alter the result
workload_cases.mandatory_outcome: fail-closed coverage policy and deterministic semantic selection

measurement_protocol.correctness: Run policy conformance and independent-oracle assertions before recording any performance result. Preserve negative controls proving that invalid coverage, wrong frames and missing critical content are rejected.

rendered_runs.aggregate: median and spread of repeat-level p50/p95/p99; do not pool samples in a way that hides run-to-run variation

measurement_protocol.timing: Record CPU frame interval and GPU timestamp where supported; do not infer GPU time from CPU wall time.
measurement_protocol.deterministic_cases: Freeze camera waypoints and synthetic asset-residency event streams. Seed any stochastic generator and record its seed.
measurement_protocol.build: Record exact commit SHA, fixture SHA-256, dependency lockfile digest, Rust toolchain, build profile, feature flags and shader/asset digests.
measurement_protocol.hardware: Record CPU, GPU, memory, OS/kernel, graphics driver, API/backend, display/render resolution, power profile and thermal state when available.
measurement_protocol.unavailable_measurement: If the runtime or required instrumentation is unavailable, report null with a reason; never substitute a synthetic estimate for a measurement.

performance_targets.note: These are engineering targets for measured frame intervals, not assertions about current Symtropy performance. GPU time, correctness and memory must be reported alongside them.

claim_ceiling: Fixture and protocol only; no performance result is implied.
A screen-space-error setting is not itself evidence of equal visual quality across engines.
Do not claim SOTA or superiority until a matched renderer track produces reproducible measurements on the same workload.
Synthetic orbit guides and static illustrative positions are not an astronomical ephemeris.
No performance improvement may trade away protected-content retention, coordinate correctness, or complete-coverage invariants.
